aboutMe.title: About
aboutMe.description: I'm a full stack web developer from Argentina with a passion for creating beautiful and functional web applications. I have experience in both front-end and back-end development, and I'm always eager to learn new technologies and improve my skills.

projects.title: Projects

projects.description_2_project_1: The idea started to digitalize a family business, and to make the sale of the products more automatic.

projects.description_2_project_2: The idea was to improve the experience of athletes and fans when viewing the results of the tournaments.

projects.description_2_project_3: It was developed with Python, specifically with the pygame library. SQLite was used for data persistence and statistics management.
